title: Learned code design for the quantum switch of depolarising channels
result: Gradient-designed encoder-decoder for a quantum switch of depolarising channels: entanglement fidelity 0.6250 (best 0.7100) versus 0.4500 for the fixed protocol, in exact simulation.

title: Shot Cost of Non-Markovian Memory Witnesses on a Qubit
result: Bootstrap max-rise test for the BLP revival criterion holds false alarms at or below 0.047 where the raw rule exceeds 0.969; relative entropy needs 3.7 to 6.8 times more shots than trace distance.

title: Learned Trotter circuits costed in fault-tolerant T gates
result: Learned all angles of Strang-shaped Ising propagator circuits: 1.70x fewer T gates than Strang/Suzuki at error 0.1 (n=6, t=1: 2238 vs 3795) and 4.1x lower error at equal rotations (simulation).

title: Blinking-aware g2(0) certification for single-photon sources
result: Envelope-fit g2(0) estimator for coincidence histograms: median absolute bias 0.064 times the best flat-plateau baseline, 95% coverage 0.937-0.960 up to 30-pulse blinking times (simulation).

title: Shot-cost break-even for Rydberg-atom MIS sampling and tier routing
result: Exact simulation of a Rydberg sweep vs QAOA and classical samplers on 120 unit-disk graphs: fewer shots on only 17.5 % of instances; median break-even shot cost 10.0 site updates.

title: Local vs Global Cost under Noise: Barren-Plateau Shot Cost
result: Exact noisy simulation (3-8 qubits) shows a local cost needs 5.1-7.4x fewer shots than a global cost at 8 qubits (log depth), but Adam trained the global cost better.

title: Adaptive vs hardware-efficient VQE under noise-induced barren plateaus
result: Exact density-matrix study (n=4-8) showing the depth-n VQE gradient decay steepens from -0.150 to -0.2615 ln-units per qubit at CNOT error 0.01, and locating break-even noise against mean field.

title: Power-mean error budgets for a repetition-code memory
result: Power-mean budget predicted combined logical error within 0.86-0.99 of Monte Carlo, where the additive one-at-a-time budget gave 0.16-0.36, in a circuit-level repetition-code simulation.

title: Noise bias vs variance in federated quantum classifiers
result: Density-matrix study of 4 noisy clients: calibrated attenuation correction cut test MSE from 0.465 to 0.440 at 8 shots (4/5 seeds, not significant); Fisher weighting did not help.

title: Noise-aware MPDO simulation of noisy Trotter quench circuits
result: Noise-aware matrix-product density-operator simulation vs ideal MPS (n=6-12, 3 seeds): break-even at two-qubit error p2 ~0.084; ~2.9e3x costlier at p2=0.01; Aer-validated to 1.6e-15.

title: Erasure-invisible loss bias in dual-rail memory: echo vs inversion
result: Exact Lindblad study of dual-rail erasure postselection: bias follows (2 eta T)^2/24 (slope 1.999); calibrated inversion cuts Bloch error 20x at hold 0.3, echo wins only for accurate pulses and drift.

title: Shot-budgeted Nystrom approximation of quantum kernels
result: Shot-accounted Nystrom quantum-kernel SVM: 0.898 vs 0.829 balanced accuracy for the full-kernel SVM at 3.2e6 shots (6 qubits, simulated); never significantly worse in 36 noise-budget cells.

title: Entanglement-entropy features versus the distances they are built from
result: When does an entanglement-entropy descriptor of landmark distances beat the distances themselves and a fidelity quantum kernel? Six qubits, five seeds, snapshot-shot cost, depolarising-noise sweep and ablation.

title: Quantum convolutional networks near a topological phase transition
result: How many state copies does a trained quantum convolutional neural network need to recognise the SPT phase of a cluster-Ising chain near criticality, compared with string order and a learned Pauli classifier? Gate and readout noise grid, MPS truncation, N = 8 to 16.

title: Gate budget of a hypercube mixer for constrained QAOA
result: Gate cost of a Boolean-minimised hypercube mixer for budget-constrained QAOA via Qiskit transpilation, and the two-qubit error below which it beats slack-penalty QAOA and classical sampling controls. Six to ten items, five seeds.

title: Kernel-aware decoherence-free pairing under correlated dephasing
result: Exact compile-time pairing of qubits into decoherence-free-subspace logical qubits under spatially correlated dephasing: kernel shape, geometry mismatch, Ramsey calibration shots, break-even gate error and a CPMG baseline. Six to twelve qubits, five seeds.

title: Anytime-valid stopping rules for shot-based circuit tests
result: When can a shot-based quantum circuit test stop? A Hoeffding sequential test against stability stopping, a fixed-budget TV threshold and a chi-square assertion, evaluated on exact noisy outputs for three to six qubits.

title: Retry windows and delay-line loss in photonic fusion nodes
result: How many repeat-until-success attempts should a photonic fusion node get when retries cost delay-line loss? Synchronous-clock model, cubic fusion-network erasure test, optimal window and loss budget over five seeds.

title: Physics-fitted simulator versus GAN for charge stability diagrams
result: With few unlabelled measurements, does fitting a physics-structured simulator beat a CycleGAN-style translator for double quantum dot charge stability diagrams? Sweeps of target-set size and unmodelled artefacts, three seeds.

title: Shot cost and noise floor of the VQLS precision certificate
result: How many shots, and how little hardware noise, does it take to issue the precision certificate of a Variational Quantum Linear Solver? Shot scaling, noise floor, zero-noise extrapolation, depth ablation and a conjugate-gradient baseline.

title: Relabelling versus reprogramming on lossy Mach-Zehnder meshes
result: How much loss-inclusive fidelity can port relabelling and phase re-optimisation recover on Reck and Clements meshes with phase-dependent per-device loss? Four to sixteen modes, calibration-error sweep, two- and three-photon statistics.

title: Noisy quantum proposals in Metropolis sampling of a gauge-Higgs model
result: How hardware noise biases quantum-proposal Metropolis sampling of a Z2 gauge-Higgs model, using exact transition matrices (four to ten qubits), Pauli-twirl and readout-flip mitigation, and ablation, damping and size sweeps.

title: Cat-qubit magic-state factory costing
result: How the bit-flip floor of a cat-qubit repetition code changes the cheapest multi-level 15-to-1 magic-state factory: exact 15-to-1 filter, an 8355-design search over cat size, levels and distances, and a bias-blind baseline.

title: Label-scarce fraud detection: quantum versus classical classifiers
result: Do a fidelity-kernel SVM and a data re-uploading circuit beat tuned and parameter-matched classical models on label-scarce, imbalanced, fraud-like data? Learning curves, noise sweep and ablation, four qubits, five seeds.

title: Shot-fair benchmark of damped quantum natural gradient for VQE
result: Does damped quantum natural gradient still beat parameter-shift Adam and SPSA when every shot is charged? VQE on a four- to eight-qubit Ising ring with shot and gate-noise sweeps and a redundant-ansatz ablation.

title: Loss-optimal switch trees for photon-source multiplexing
result: Exact dynamic program for the loss-optimal, unbalanced switch tree of a heralded photon-source multiplexer, against balanced trees, cascades and hill climbing. Scaling law, loss-mismatch map and a Monte Carlo check.

title: How much of the QAOA noise budget is a compiler decision?
result: A commutation-aware router against Qiskit SABRE and a swap network on a line-connected device, with exact density-matrix noise, an ablation, scaling to n = 10 and a classical baseline.

title: Imperfect erasure flags in toric-code decoding
result: How much does imperfect erasure-flag efficiency cost matching decoding of the toric code, does recalibrating the unflagged prior help, and how does a flag-aware neural decoder compare? L = 3 to 7, three seeds.

title: Satellite observation scheduling with CVaR-trained QAOA
result: Does CVaR training help QAOA for satellite observation scheduling (max-weight independent set) under finite-shot training and CNOT-count-dependent noise? Baselines: expectation QAOA, random, annealing, greedy.

title: Estimation-error floor in QAOA portfolio selection
result: How much of QAOA's optimisation error in cardinality-constrained portfolio selection is hidden by estimation error in returns? Penalty versus Dicke and XY-mixer QAOA against classical baselines, 12 qubits.

title: Joint-fit interleaved randomized benchmarking
result: Does a joint, shot-weighted fit of interleaved randomized-benchmarking curves beat two independent fits for single-gate error under coherent noise and small shot budgets? PTM simulation, five seeds, ablation, readout sweep.

title: Repetition-code break-even map
result: How much margin does a bit-flip repetition-code memory have over an idling qubit versus cycle time, readout error and gate error under T1-limited noise, with an exact space-time decoder (d = 3, 5, 7).

title: Measurement-reduced erasure recovery on toric and bivariate bicycle codes
result: How many stabiliser measurements and syndrome-extraction CNOTs does erasure recovery need when only checks touching erased qubits are measured? Toric and bivariate bicycle codes, n = 32 to 144.

title: QAOA best-of-K sampling under gate noise
result: How depolarising gate noise degrades the best-of-K cut of QAOA (p = 1, 2) on 3-regular MaxCut, against random sampling and an equal-budget hill climber, using exact density matrices for n = 6 to 10.

title: Photon-budget-aware characterisation of photonic meshes
result: At equal photon-preparation budget, does two-photon (HOM-type) data beat single-photon intensities for characterising beamsplitter errors of a Mach-Zehnder mesh before recompiling it? Four to six modes, three seeds.

title: Rydberg-EIT radio-frequency estimation: model fit versus learned estimators
result: Cramer-Rao-limited model fit against an MLP and a four-qubit data re-uploading circuit for Rydberg-atom EIT electrometry under coupling-laser drift and detection noise, using a four-level Lindblad model.

title: Heralded versus unheralded noise in monitored Clifford circuits
result: Stabiliser simulation of how dephasing, unheralded and heralded erasure shift the measurement rate at which a monitored random Clifford circuit keeps a reference qubit's coherent information (L = 8 to 16).

title: Chip-aware QAOA placement on modular quantum devices
result: Kernighan-Lin placement raises noisy QAOA MaxCut approximation ratio by 0.04-0.06 at a 20x coupler error ratio (n = 8 to 12, simulation).

title: XY-mixer versus penalty QAOA: noise crossover
result: Finds the noise level where the gate overhead of a constrained XY mixer cancels its feasibility advantage on densest-k-subgraph.

title: Co-design of frequency and bandwidth conversion for heterogeneous quantum links
result: Noise-aware co-design of quantum frequency conversion and bandwidth matching; in simulation, median 4.1x higher distillable entanglement at 100 km.

title: QML advantage benchmarking
result: QAOA vs brute-force MaxCut on graphs of 4 to 12 nodes, tracking approximation ratio and runtime to locate the crossover regime.

title: Hardware-efficient QPU ansatz
result: VQE for the H2 ground state with an Ry/Rz and nearest-neighbour CNOT ansatz matched to QPU topology.

title: Zero-noise extrapolation for error mitigation
result: Unitary folding and Richardson extrapolation recover noise-free expectation values from simulated depolarising noise.

title: Tensor-network many-body ground states
result: From-scratch MPS for the transverse-field Ising model, validated against exact diagonalisation, with entanglement entropy.

title: Trotterized quantum dynamics
result: Suzuki-Trotter simulation of an XY spin chain on gate-based circuits, compared with exact time evolution.

title: QAOA Max-Cut with RL-inspired tuning
result: QAOA Max-Cut in Qiskit whose iterative parameter tuning mirrors RL policy optimisation, with a command-line interface.

title: Quantum-walk influence maximization
result: Continuous-time quantum walk finds influential nodes in scale-free networks via interference, with a linear-threshold spread simulation.

title: Quantum recurrent attention for EV battery state of health
result: MQAttn-QLSTM-VQR: a 988-parameter quantum recurrent attention model compared with a parameter-matched classical twin on three datasets.

title: TIDAL: underwater acoustic network resource allocation
result: Simulation repository for two-timescale, deadline- and Doppler-aware resource allocation in mission-critical underwater acoustic networks (code to follow).

title: Quantum-like fuzzy MAGDM benchmark
result: Empirical benchmarking of quantum-like fuzzy multiattribute group decision making (code to follow).
